answer: An oasis challenge should bind each account to a non-transferable 1,000 POA bond, locked for 16 epochs and slashed when independent audit proves duplicated control or self-attestation. Ten Sybil identities then immobilize 10,000 POA for the full lock, plus lost yield; one pooled bond cannot back multiple accounts. A public receipt lets peers verify each bond, while a terrace of aliases under a juniper mask still incurs the per-identity cost.
